_comment: Datreon blog content backlog. The Mon/Wed/Fri routine picks the first item with status 'pending', writes the post, then sets its status to 'published' with the date. Add new items to the end to keep the pipeline full. Categories map to eyebrow labels on the post.

queue.title: LLMs Behind the Firewall: Integrating AI Without Leaking Your Data
queue.angle: How to use LLMs on sensitive/regulated data safely: deployment options (API with DPA, private/VPC, self-hosted open models), data-handling patterns (redaction, retrieval boundaries, no-training guarantees), and how to choose. Reassuring, practical, for security-conscious buyers.
queue.visual: SVG data-flow diagram contrasting 'data leaves your boundary' vs 'data stays inside'; table comparing hosted API / private cloud / self-hosted on control, cost, effort.

queue.title: The Real Cost of Legacy Software (and How to Calculate Yours)
queue.angle: The hidden costs beyond the license line: slower delivery, security exposure, key-person risk, integration tax, opportunity cost. Give a simple way to estimate annual carrying cost. Motivates modernization without fear-mongering.
queue.visual: SVG cost-iceberg (visible vs hidden costs); table of cost categories with how-to-estimate each.

queue.title: No Account Managers, No Handoffs: What Boutique Delivery Actually Buys You
queue.angle: The structural advantage of a small senior team vs a large firm: fewer layers, direct access, faster decisions, real ownership. Ties to 'One Team. Total Ownership.' Not a big-firm hit piece — an honest tradeoff.
queue.visual: SVG org-layers diagram (many layers between client and engineers vs one team, direct); table comparing the two on speed, access, accountability, cost of coordination.

queue.title: Before You Buy an AI Tool: A 5-Question Readiness Check
queue.angle: Five concrete questions a non-technical leader should answer before buying/building AI: what decision does it change, is the data reachable, how do we measure right, what happens when it's wrong, who owns it. Practical gate.
queue.visual: SVG 5-step readiness flow/checklist; table of question -> good answer vs red flag.

queue.title: Rebuild vs. Refactor vs. Replace: A Decision Framework
queue.angle: When to incrementally refactor, when to replace a module, when to rebuild — with an honest decision framework based on change rate, risk, and strategic fit. Complements the strangler-fig post.
queue.visual: SVG decision tree; table comparing the three paths on risk, time-to-value, cost, when-to-use.

queue.title: How to Build a Data Dashboard Your Team Will Actually Use
queue.angle: Most dashboards get built and ignored. Principles that make one get used daily: one decision per view, the right grain, trust in the numbers, speed, and defaults. Practical and opinionated.
queue.visual: SVG side-by-side 'cluttered vs focused' dashboard sketch; table of principle -> what it looks like in practice.

queue.title: Legacy Modernization for Government: Upgrading Aging Systems Without Downtime
queue.angle: Modernizing government systems where downtime and risk are unacceptable: phased approach, parallel running, compliance/ATO continuity, stakeholder trust. Targets federal/state program offices.
queue.visual: SVG phased migration timeline with 'system stays up' band; table of risk -> mitigation.

queue.title: AI Automation vs. Hiring: How to Decide What to Automate First
queue.angle: A framework for deciding which work to automate vs staff: task volume, variability, error tolerance, and judgment required. Helps leaders sequence automation sensibly rather than automating the wrong things.
queue.visual: SVG 2x2 (volume vs variability) with 'automate first / augment / keep human' zones; ROI table.

queue.title: Cloud Migration Without the Surprise Bill: A Cost Playbook
queue.angle: Why cloud bills balloon and how to migrate cost-consciously: right-sizing, the lift-and-shift trap, managed-service tradeoffs, tagging/observability from day one. Practical FinOps for small teams.
queue.visual: SVG diagram of cost drivers; table of common overspend -> fix.

queue.title: A Small Business's Guide to Delivering Software the Government Can Actually Accept
queue.angle: What it takes for gov software delivery beyond code: security controls, documentation, ATO basics, accessibility (508), and acceptance criteria. Demystifies gov delivery for small firms and reassures gov buyers.
queue.visual: SVG acceptance/ATO flow; checklist table of requirement -> what it means.

queue.title: From Raw Data to Decisions: The Data Pipeline, Explained
queue.angle: A plain-language tour of what turns messy source data into trustworthy decisions: ingest, clean, model, serve, monitor. For leaders who keep hearing 'pipeline' and want to understand what they're paying for.
queue.visual: SVG horizontal pipeline (ingest -> clean -> model -> serve -> monitor); table of stage -> what goes wrong without it.

queue.title: What Good DevOps Actually Buys You (Beyond the Buzzwords)
queue.angle: Translate DevOps/CI-CD into business outcomes: faster releases, fewer outages, faster recovery, less firefighting. Concrete before/after, not jargon.
queue.visual: SVG before/after release pipeline (manual/slow vs automated/fast); table of DORA-style metric -> what improves.

queue.title: Document Processing With AI: Turning a 3-Hour Task Into 3 Minutes
queue.angle: A grounded look at automating document-heavy workflows (intake, extraction, classification, routing) with AI — where it shines, where humans stay in the loop, and how to measure it. Case-study framing (illustrative).
queue.visual: SVG before/after workflow (manual steps vs AI-assisted with human check); table of task -> time before/after.

queue.title: What 'AI Readiness' Really Means for a Federal Program Office
queue.angle: Federal-specific AI readiness: data governance, authority to operate, risk framing, human oversight, and starting with low-risk internal use cases. Targets program offices exploring AI responsibly.
queue.visual: SVG readiness matrix (value vs risk with 'start here' zone for gov); table of dimension -> not ready vs ready.

queue.title: React vs. Angular in 2026: Choosing a Front End That Won't Trap You
queue.angle: A balanced, non-tribal comparison for decision-makers: team fit, hiring, longevity, complexity, and the real question (it's rarely the framework). Long-tail SEO magnet.
queue.visual: SVG decision-factors diagram; table comparing React vs Angular on learning curve, ecosystem, structure, best-fit.

queue.title: Why We Don't Subcontract the Core Work
queue.angle: An opinion piece on the cost of subcontracting the critical build: lost context, diluted accountability, quality drift. Reinforces Datreon's model. Ties to 'One Team. Total Ownership.'
queue.visual: SVG ownership-chain diagram (intact vs broken by subcontracting); table of what breaks at each handoff.

queue.title: Your First 90 Days on the Cloud: A Sane Setup for Small Teams
queue.angle: A pragmatic starter setup for a small team going to AWS/Azure/GCP: accounts/identity, guardrails, cost controls, CI/CD, observability — in the right order, without over-engineering.
queue.visual: SVG 90-day timeline with milestones; checklist table by phase.

queue.title: A Non-Technical Founder's Glossary: 20 Software Terms That Matter in a Vendor Contract
queue.angle: Plain-English definitions of terms that show up in software contracts and why each matters to the buyer (SLA, IP assignment, source escrow, scope, acceptance, warranty, etc.). Highly shareable, strong SEO.
queue.visual: SVG 'where these terms live in a contract' diagram; glossary table of term -> plain meaning -> why it matters.
